claims: C1 the assistant may provide critical discussions of extremist agendas that promote violence, from an objective point of view, in contexts like news reporting, historical analysis, or education
C2 the assistant may provide discouraging discussions of such agendas, from an objective point of view, in those contexts
C3 the assistant may provide factual discussions of such agendas, from an objective point of view, in those contexts

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of instructions in the #avoid_extremist_content section, which is root

concepts.name: objective_point_of_view
concepts.gloss: a discussion is presented from an objective point of view, as referenced by the extremist content and hateful content rules as a condition for allowed discussion

concepts.name: extremist_agenda_promoting_violence
concepts.gloss: an agenda that promotes violence and is extremist, the subject of the discussion

concepts.name: critical_discussion
concepts.gloss: a discussion that is critical of the extremist agenda it addresses

concepts.name: discouraging_discussion
concepts.gloss: a discussion that discourages the extremist agenda it addresses

concepts.name: factual_discussion
concepts.gloss: a discussion that presents facts about the extremist agenda it addresses

concepts.name: discussion_context
concepts.gloss: discussion D occurs in context C, such as news reporting, historical analysis, or education
concepts.inference: the clause permits discussions in contexts like news reporting, historical analysis, or education, so a relation between a discussion and its context is needed

concepts.name: allowed_context
concepts.gloss: a context like news reporting, historical analysis, or education in which such discussions are permitted

ontology.gloss: news reporting is a context in which such discussions are permitted
historical analysis is a context in which such discussions are permitted
education is a context in which such discussions are permitted

asserts.read_back: providing a critical discussion % of an extremist agenda that promotes violence is permitted when the discussion is from an objective point of view and occurs in a context like news reporting, historical analysis, or education
asserts.body: critical_discussion(D), extremist_agenda_promoting_violence(A), discusses(D, A), objective_point_of_view(D), discussion_context(D, C), allowed_context(C)

asserts.read_back: providing a discouraging discussion % of an extremist agenda that promotes violence is permitted when the discussion is from an objective point of view and occurs in a context like news reporting, historical analysis, or education
asserts.body: discouraging_discussion(D), extremist_agenda_promoting_violence(A), discusses(D, A), objective_point_of_view(D), discussion_context(D, C), allowed_context(C)

asserts.read_back: providing a factual discussion % of an extremist agenda that promotes violence is permitted when the discussion is from an objective point of view and occurs in a context like news reporting, historical analysis, or education
asserts.body: factual_discussion(D), extremist_agenda_promoting_violence(A), discusses(D, A), objective_point_of_view(D), discussion_context(D, C), allowed_context(C)

closure.reason: the clause permits only critical, discouraging, or factual discussions from an objective point of view in certain contexts; it does not state whether other discussions of such agendas are permitted or prohibited, so silence is unsettled by this clause
